children: its preliminary third-quarter 2026 financial results, replacing previously reported net income with a net loss following post-closing adjustments related to the sale of assets to Trackonomy Systems.
The company now expects a preliminary net loss of $1.1M to $1.3M, or $0.05 to $0.06 per share, compared with its earlier estimate of net income of $0.4M to $0.8M, or $0.01 to $0.02 per share.
The revisions reflect working capital adjustments and the post-closing acceptance of certain customer contracts associated with the asset sale.
INVE said all other preliminary results remain unchanged, including its expected cash balance of $87.1M as of Sept. 30, 2026. The company had initially released its preliminary results on Oct. 21.

title: INVE Technologies revises Q3 preliminary results, swings to net loss
